basic_details.job_title: RVNL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Additional General Manager / Joint General Manager / Senior Deputy General Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: One deputation post of Addl. General Manager / Joint General Manager / Sr. Deputy General Manager (Civil) at Chandigarh is open in Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd. (RVNL), in the IRSE / Civil Engg. Department. Pay is parent pay plus deputation allowance, for five years subject to the Government's approval for exemption to RVNL from the rule of immediate absorption. Age must be below 56 years. Candidates must apply through proper channel in the prescribed proforma and send an advance scanned PDF copy to [email protected]. how_to_apply: Apply through proper channel for selection on deputation basis in the prescribed proforma, which is available at the web address indicated in the notice.
Fill in the proforma completely. It asks that blanks not be left, and includes the vacancy notice number, the post applied for and the choice of station (wherever applicable).
Send a scanned copy of the duly filled in and signed proforma in PDF format directly by email to [email protected] as an advance copy.

The concerned Controlling Officer / Zonal Railways etc. may forward the applications of only eligible candidates, with Vigilance/DAR clearance and last 05 years APAR grading, to [email protected] within 15 days of the closing date.

A declaration that the details are true and that the applicant is eligible as per the vacancy notice, with name, signature, place and date.

content_sections.heading: About RVNL
content_sections.text: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd. (RVNL) issued this vacancy notice through its Joint General Manager/HR on 20 November 2026. The post sits in the Civil Engg. Department and is located at Chandigarh. The notice invites officers for selection on deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for age and eligibility is the closing date of the vacancy notice. Eligibility is by the grade each officer holds substantively. The notice prints no educational qualification. Posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR Posts in Level-13 (CDA) and having 12-14 years' service in Group 'A', OR Posts in IDA E-6 grade (Rs. 90000-240000/-) for four years. Posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR Posts in Level-12 (CDA) and having 8-12 years' service in Group 'A', OR Posts carrying grade IDA E-5 (Rs. 80000-220000/-) for four years. Posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR Posts in Sr. Scale (Level-11), OR Posts in Gr. 'B' (Level-10) and having 10 years of service in Group 'B' (Gazetted), OR Posts carrying grade IDA E-4 (Rs. 70000-200000/-) for four years. In each case, officers must be holding the posts substantively. Preference will be given to candidates having experience of planning, execution and management of infrastructure projects in CPSEs/PSUs or Central/State Government companies/organizations. Below 56 years, reckoned as on the closing date of the vacancy notice. The notice prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each grade, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scale of pay is parent pay plus deputation allowance. The notice prints no amount for the deputation allowance. Terms of appointment: deputation. Duration: five years, subject to Govt.'s approval for exemption to RVNL from the rule of immediate absorption. Location: Chandigarh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RVNL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply through proper channel for selection on deputation basis in the prescribed proforma, which is available at the web address indicated in the notice. Fill in the proforma completely. It asks that blanks not be left, and includes the vacancy notice number, the post applied for and the choice of station (wherever applicable). Send a scanned copy of the duly filled in and signed proforma in PDF format directly by email to [email protected] as an advance copy. The concerned Controlling Officer / Zonal Railways etc. may forward the applications of only eligible candidates, with Vigilance/DAR clearance and last 05 years APAR grading, to [email protected] within 15 days of the closing date. Personal data: name, gender, service, department, category, date of birth, age as on the closing date, date of entry into time scale (DITS), date of entry in Group B (wherever applicable). Present grade/pay level in Pay Matrix (7th CPC) with basic pay, present post, email ID, mobile number, present organisation address and Personnel/HR department contact details. Educational qualifications, experience details, details of previous deputation/foreign assignment, and a photograph. Whether debarred from deputation, and whether the cooling-off period is completed with date of return from previous deputation. APAR ratings for the last 5 years, with copies of APARs/grading attached (not to be left blank), awards, punishments in career, and whether presently undergoing punishment. A declaration that the details are true and that the applicant is eligible as per the vacancy notice, with name, signature, place and date.
